Test print stylesheet rendering for the SamDTU CME accreditation certificate via Playwright PDF emulation.
Verify zero unhandled browser console errors or failed network requests across the entire portal tree.
Verify `unicorn_health/vercel.json` cleanUrls, trailingSlash, and route rewrite matrix.
Audit production deployment status on `https://unicorn-health-uzbekistan.vercel.app`.
Validate Turnir production packaging script (`npm run pack`) creates valid `submission.zip`.
Verify GSD task board (`gsd/BOARD.md`) status and update active specifications.
Audit Git working tree: stage all verified assets and create clean atomic commit.
Verify `scripts/autonomous_prompt_runner.py` execution state and persistence in `gsd/autonomous_state.json`.
Configure 5-minute recurring autonomous daemon tick schedule via Antigravity `schedule` tool.
Verify real-time terminal progress reporting and log streaming in `gsd/logs/autonomous_execution.log`.
Conduct comprehensive final diff audit, secret audit, and test suite execution.
Generate the Executive Master Dossier artifact summarizing completed work, active automations, and next autonomous cycles.
